title: IVG Smart Max Pola Mint Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Polar Mint delivers a pure and invigorating Mint flavour with an extra-cool finish. The taste is sharp and clean with a lingering chill, offering a refreshing vape that’s ideal for fans of punchy Menthol and Mint profiles. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the refill chamber automatically tops up the pod during use and can support up to 10,000 puffs depending on your vaping style. No refilling or coil swaps required. This pod uses mesh coil technology for consistent flavour and smooth MTL vapour. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
